serviceTimeByLoad.how: the staircase's work per request, its CPU per request net of idle times the machine's thread speed during the pass (1.7353 ms at 50, 0.9330 ms at 722, 0.9662 ms at 1345 req/s), fitted as a law of the rate, 0.9051 + 41.34 × rate^-1 ms, over the top rate's (0.9358 ms); carried to 2,164 req/s, where the service's 2 CPUs fill, then flat
